content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00180 If for a dataElement to be sent a NonqueuedSenderComSpec with handleOut- OfRange = invalid is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the sending component. If the value is out of bounds, the value actually sent shall be set to the invalidValue . In case of a composite datatype each composite element whose actual value is out of bounds shall be set to the invalidValue .
